title: Asking for a day off
instructions: Can yöneticisinden izin istiyor. Neden istediğine ve anlaşmaya dikkat et.

script.speaker: can
script.text: Excuse me, Sarah. Have you got a minute?

script.speaker: boss
script.text: Of course, Can. What is it?

script.speaker: can
script.text: Could I have next Friday off? My sister is getting married.

script.speaker: boss
script.text: Oh, congratulations! Hmm, Friday is busy. We have the meeting with the new client.

script.speaker: can
script.text: I know. I can prepare everything on Thursday, and Ahmet can do the meeting.

script.speaker: can
script.text: Yes, I asked him this morning.

script.speaker: boss
script.text: Then that's fine. Enjoy the wedding!

questions.prompt: Why does Can want a day off?

options: There's a meeting with a new client.
It's the end of the month.
questions.evidence: We have the meeting with the new client.
and Ahmet can do the meeting.
I can prepare everything on Thursday
